metaDescription:
🌴Sitio Aplaya at Lio Estate, El Nido – A Premier Mixed-Use Community in Palawan

Sitio Aplaya is an exceptional mixed-use community within Lio Estate, El Nido, Palawan, offering a rare opportunity to invest in one of the Philippines' most sought-after island destinations. Developed as part of the master-planned Lio Estate, Sitio Aplaya is designed to integrate residential, commercial, hospitality, and lifestyle spaces into a vibrant coastal neighborhood.
title: SITIO APLAYA-LIO ESTATE
description: Sitio Aplaya is the newest mixed-use district within Lio Estate, Ayala Land's master-planned eco-tourism development in El Nido, Palawan. Designed as a vibrant community where nature, business, and modern island living come together, Sitio Aplaya offers a rare opportunity for investors, entrepreneurs, hospitality operators, and future residents to be part of one of the Philippines' most prestigious sustainable tourism destinations. It forms part of the continuing expansion of Lio Estate, with a strong focus on preserving the natural beauty of El Nido while supporting long-term economic growth.
